customManagers.description: npm packages pinned in MCP server args, e.g. @azure/mcp@2.0.5

packageRules.description: Plugin files change: the versioning rule applies
prBodyNotes: This changes a plugin folder. Before merging, bump `version` in that plugin's `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.

packageRules.description: Eval mocks copy the Azure MCP tool list: refresh it on a bump
prBodyNotes: The eval suite mocks this server. Run `pnpm mocks:tools` and commit the new `evals/mocks/azure/_tools.json`, then run `pnpm test`: it fails if a mock names a tool this version no longer has. Rename or drop that mock, and re-run `pnpm eval` for its cases.
